recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century modern album cover featuring a close-up, warm-toned portrait of a female vocalist with eyes closed, set against a textured orange-red background. The layout uses a distinct top header bar and right-aligned block typography characteristic of 1960s recording labels.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's serene expression contrasted with vibrant, textured background
Top horizontal header bar anchoring the primary title
Right-justified secondary text block balancing the subject's left-leaning head tilt
coreInvariants: Warm, saturated color palette (orange, red, peach)
Soft-focus studio lighting with gentle shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the lower two-thirds and left half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's closed eyes and red lips serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top header, moves down to the subject's face, then right to the secondary text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Textured orange background provides breathing room on the right side.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm orange-red background and peach-toned skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and light blue text for readability against dark and warm tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black hair and vibrant red lipstick.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with soft, mid-value transitions on the subject's face.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and primary accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric slab serifs and clean sans-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky slab serifs for the artist name
Clean, wide-set sans-serif for the header
Tight leading in the secondary text block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy slab serif for the main artist and a light, spaced-out sans-serif for the technical header.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif aesthetic of the era.
Suitable for the secondary sans-serif header text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a portrait of a woman with black hair and red lips, eyes closed in a serene expression, wearing a peach-colored sweater. The background should be a textured, warm orange-red studio backdrop. Leave a white horizontal bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal bar at the top with small red and blue sans-serif text. Place a large, right-aligned block of white slab-serif text in the upper right quadrant of the main image area.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette predominantly warm (orange/red)?
Is the main text block right-aligned?
Does the subject have a soft-focus, mid-century photographic quality?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top header bar
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the slab serif is sufficiently bold
Check that the header bar is perfectly horizontal
Confirm the skin tones look natural within the warm lighting
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a close-up, emotive portrait with a textured monochromatic background, a top-bar header for technical info, and a bold, right-justified slab-serif block for the primary subject name.
